_doc: IDENTITY-TRANSFORM mocap map for mpc_tune ONLY. The tuning harness works entirely in the RAW MOCAP FRAME (start pose = mocap origin, workspace +-2 m), so x0/y0/theta0/yaw_offset are all zero here -- unlike MPC/config/mocap_map_config.json, which carries the world/planner transform (x0=1.9, y0=2.5, theta0=0.0) used by mars_sim_viz. TWO fields are deliberately COPIED from that file and must track it if it ever changes: 'aliases' (without the Motive-asset -> robot-name mapping the bridge publishes under a name nothing subscribes to) and 'y_up' (which selects the mocap UP-AXIS, i.e. which physical plane the 2D pose is taken from -- that is NOT part of the world transform being dropped). Run the bridge with --map-config MARS/config/mpc_tune_mocap_map.json --loc-port-start 3270 so it cannot collide with a bridge mars_sim_viz may already have bound on 3260.
_doc_pose_filter: See doc/MOCAP_POSE_FILTER_PLAN.md. Same shipped-default, disabled-by-default pose_filter block as MPC/config/mocap_map_config.json -- copied here (a THIRD field that must track that file, alongside 'aliases'/'y_up' -- see this file's own _doc above) so mpc_tune runs get the same filter behavior once it's validated and enabled. Override live via --pose-filter on|off.
